Linear search checks items sequentially. Binary search halves the search interval on
sorted indexed data.
Linear search එක item එකින් එක බලනවා. Binary search එක middle value එක compare කරලා search area එක අඩකින් අඩු කරනවා. Array එක sorted Jවන්න ඕJන්.
Finding a product ID in a sorted list.
binary(new int[]{2,4,6,8,10},8) returns 3. Worst time O(log n), space O(1).
Why must binary search use sorted data?
Ordering tells us which half can safely be discarded.
